# 2 Baruch Chapter 70 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**70:1** "And-after-those-things hear-about-the-eighth black-waters and-the-bright-waters which-follow-them."

**70:2** "Those-black-waters which-you-saw after-the-seventh-bright-waters: these-are-the-whole-world which-comes-after-those-things, and-the-deeds-of-the-Gentiles, and-the-evils-which-will-be-in-those-times."

**70:3** "For-there-will-come-upon-them great-disorders, and-there-will-be-many-unrighteous deeds-done, and-much-apostasy, and-many-kings-will-be-established, but-they-will-perish-quickly."

**70:4** "And-there-will-be-tumults in-all-the-earth, and-each-will-hate his-neighbour, and-each-will-provoke his-neighbour-to-war."

**70:5** "And-it-will-come-to-pass that-those-who-know-not-the-law will-be-killed by-those-who-do-not-know the-good."

**70:6** "And-there-will-be-wars-and-disasters, and-everywhere-there-will-be-a-sword-against-a-sword; and-the-nations-will-be-in-confusion."

**70:7** "And-the-time-of-my-Messiah will-come, and-he-will-make-men-call-upon-my-name, and-the-good-things which-I-have-decreed-for-my-people will-be-given-to-them."

**70:8** "And-there-will-be-a-great-fire in-the-earth, and-the-mountains-will-melt, and-the-valleys-will-shake, and-the-waters-will-change-their-nature."

**70:9** "And-those-who-have-lived-in-the-darkness will-come-into-the-light, and-the-righteous-ones will-be-separated-from-the-wicked."

**70:10** "These-are-the-eighth-black-waters which-you-saw."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
